opening.argument: The speaker presents a walkthrough of the steps he says he used to appeal a rejected Facebook advertisement. He directs viewers to a business-help route and describes a support form asking for an account ID, page selection, and issue details. His account of contacting the claimed support team and receiving notice that the ad was active is a reported result, not an independently verified one. In this context, the claimed support identity and account-information fields are presented as part of an advertising-support workflow, not a separate money-making or credential-harvesting offer. The available evidence does not establish that the emails or support route were unauthorized or that submitted information was misused.
